claims: Sting is Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner.
Sting was born on October 2, 1951, in Wallsend, Northumberland, England.
Sting is an English musician, singer, and songwriter.
Sting is the former frontman of The Police.
Sting has sold over 100 million records.
Sting is married to Trudie Styler.
Sting was married to Frances Tomelty from 1976 to 1984.
Sting is a 17-time Grammy Award winner.
Sting is a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee.
Sting is a Commander of the British Empire.
The Police was active from 1977 to 1986.
Sting served as lead singer, bassist, and principal songwriter for The Police.
Sting's solo career continues to the present.
Sting is active as of 2026 with the "Sting 3.0" tour.
Sting has new releases as of 2026.
